name: Mithril Polyglot Review Ops (worktree-scoped)
description: One owning profile (mithril-polyglot-review-ops) continues the Go/Rust polyglot extraction expansion on the pinned worktree system-one-polyglot-extraction (feat/polyglot-source-extraction). Each hourly tick runs the two deterministic test suites, measures public-review extraction against canonical targets (HEAD via git ls-remote; no GitHub API quota; target code never executed), commits and pushes to the feature branch only when tests are green, and archives receipts to R2 under polyglot-review/ and Google Drive jklux with read-back verification. review_incomplete is not safe; findings are affected-version candidates.
author: Mithril

configuration.worktree_binding: The tick only operates on the worktree at POLYGLOT_WORKTREE (default /Users/junkawasaki/github/mithril-lang/system-one-polyglot-extraction) when it is on branch POLYGLOT_BRANCH (default feat/polyglot-source-extraction); any other branch stops the tick with TICK STOP and is never written.
configuration.targets: The profile's data/canonical/targets.json lists the measured public repositories; operator-owned, one line per target. HEAD is resolved via git ls-remote (git protocol; GitHub API quota is not consumed).
configuration.parser: MITHRIL_SOURCE_PYTHON (default ~/.venvs/mithril-source-parser/bin/python) is the pinned tree-sitter parser interpreter; without it every polyglot file is parser_runtime_unavailable and 0 files are extracted.
configuration.matching_engine: Pinned security-core (runtime/dependency-engine-pin.json, commit c4d63825241e91347ec30fef4b7a2bbfee6768cd). Go/Cargo components carry the canonical lowercase keywords (go/cargo); OSV answers under Go/crates.io.
configuration.r2: internal-security-nvd bucket (fund account 62e1fda53188460698f8c66d3aef59c6), prefix polyglot-review/ (profile-owned; no other profile writes these keys). Publish success = put+get sha256 read-back match only.
configuration.drive: Google Drive jklux archive via the profile's rclone.conf (rclone public-client token refresh; no browser UI); warn-and-continue.
configuration.git: Commit+push to feat/polyglot-source-extraction only, only when tests are green and the worktree is dirty. No merge, no PR, no main writes.
